research-synthesis-t2: {"action":"takenote","target":"claim: 2023 global surface temperature anomaly was +1.17\u00b0c (nasa giss and noaa ncei both report it; noaa's figure is relative to the 20th century average, and noaa says it is approximately +1.17\u00b0c when adjusted to the 1850-1900 baseline). sources: nasa giss annual 2023 article; https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/monitoring/monthly-report/global/202313 (published 2024-01-12). caveat: wmo reports +1.45\u00b0c using a different 1850-1900 reference methodology, so the figures differ by baseline and dataset."}
research-synthesis-t3: {"action":"takenote","target":"final synthesis: 2023 global average surface temperature anomaly was +1.17\u00b0c above the 1850-1900 pre-industrial baseline (confirmed by nasa giss and noaa ncei, note n-001). caveat: wmo reports +1.45\u00b0c using a different baseline methodology. the ipcc ar6 wg1 spm (2021) was not used because it predates 2023 and covers multi-decadal trends."}
